# temps_git_provider (Resource)

A Git host Temps clones repositories from, connected with an access token. GitHub and GitLab apps that need a browser authorization flow are set up in the console instead.

`kind` picks the host: `github`, `gitlab` and `gitea` take `token`; `bitbucket` takes `token` as an access token, or with `token_username` as an app password; `generic` takes `clone_url` and an optional `token` and `token_username`. Changing `token` updates the stored credential in place.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `git_providers:read`, `git_providers:create`, `git_providers:write`, `git_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A self-hosted Git server reached with an access token.
resource "temps_git_provider" "internal" {
  kind      = "generic"
  name      = "Internal Git"
  clone_url = "https://git.example.com"
  token     = var.git_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Type of Git host. One of `bitbucket`, `generic`, `gitea`, `github`, `gitlab`.
- `name` (String) Name of the connection.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) URL of a self-hosted GitLab or Gitea, or of a generic host's web interface.
- `clone_url` (String) Clone URL prefix of a `generic` host. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Access token, or Bitbucket app password when `token_username` is set. Temps can only update a personal access token in place: changing the token of a `generic` host or a Bitbucket app password replaces the connection. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `token_username` (String) User name sent with the token (Bitbucket app passwords and generic hosts). Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `auth_method` (String) How Temps authenticates to the host.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the connection is active.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_git_provider.internal 3
```
